// Injected only into an isolated source copy by the translated fault test.
// There is no fault route or test hook in the production kernel.
package kernel

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"math"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"syscall"

	"github.com/neria-cloud/gosim/internal/contracts"
	simrt "github.com/neria-cloud/gosim/rt/runtime"
	"github.com/neria-cloud/gosim/rt/runtime/abi"
)

func faultCheck(ok bool, message string) {
	if !ok {
		panic("fault assertion: " + message)
	}
}
func faultMust(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic("fault assertion: " + err.Error())
	}
}

// Called on the real generated driver's surviving supervisor. The fixture uses
// that one active engine, reserves disjoint machine IDs, and closes its sessions
// before returning. Every kernel/provider/fake value here is translated.
func (outer *Kernel) translatedFault(name string) {
	var log []string
	fs, net := &recordingProvider{feature: contracts.FS, log: &log}, &recordingProvider{feature: contracts.Net, log: &log}
	switch name {
	case "open-fs":
		fs.openErr = errInjected
	case "open-net":
		net.openErr = errInjected
	case "controls-fs":
		fs.badControls = true
	case "controls-net":
		net.badControls = true
	case "open-close":
		net.openErr = errInjected
		fs.panicClose = true
	}
	config := outer.config
	k, err := New(config, outer.engine, []contracts.Provider{net, fs})
	if strings.HasPrefix(name, "open-") || strings.HasPrefix(name, "controls-") {
		faultCheck(err != nil, "open fault succeeded")
		if name == "open-close" {
			faultCheck(strings.Contains(err.Error(), "close failure"), "open cleanup error lost")
		}
		data, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"msg": "fault-cleanup", "released": true, "operations": log})
		simrt.WriteLog(append(data, '\n'))
		return
	}
	faultMust(err)
	k.nextMachineID = 1000
	defer func() {
		closeErr := k.Close()
		released := true
		for _, p := range []*recordingProvider{fs, net} {
			for _, r := range p.resources {
				released = released && r.released
			}
		}
		data, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"msg": "fault-cleanup", "released": released, "operations": log, "transactions": len(k.transactions), "polls": len(k.polls), "leases": len(k.dispatcher.live)})
		simrt.WriteLog(append(data, '\n'))
		if closeErr != nil {
			k.cleanupFailure("fault session close", closeErr)
		}
	}()
	ref, err := k.Create("fault-child", func() { simrt.NewChan[int](0).Recv() })
	faultMust(err)
	switch name {
	case "prepare-fs":
		fs.prepareErr = errInjected
	case "prepare-net":
		net.prepareErr = errInjected
	case "bindings-fs":
		fs.badBindings = true
	case "bindings-net":
		net.badBindings = true
	case "rollback-errors":
		net.prepareErr = errInjected
		fs.releaseErr = errors.New("release fault")
		fs.panicAbort = true
	case "runtime-prepare":
		occupied, err := k.engine.PrepareMachine(ref.ID, 1, "occupied")
		faultMust(err)
		_, err = k.BeginStart(ref, false)
		faultCheck(errors.Is(err, simrt.ErrMachineToken), "runtime prepare failure missing")
		faultCheck(k.machineByID[ref.ID].state == StateNew && k.machineByID[ref.ID].nextEpoch == 2, "runtime failure changed ownership")
		k.engine.AbortMachine(occupied)
		faultMust(k.Start(ref))
		return
	case "machine-overflow":
		k.nextMachineID = math.MaxUint64
		_, err = k.Create("last", func() {})
		faultMust(err)
		_, _ = k.Create("overflow", func() {})
		panic("fault assertion: machine ID wrapped")
	case "epoch-overflow":
		k.machineByID[ref.ID].nextEpoch = math.MaxUint64
		tx, err := k.BeginStart(ref, false)
		faultMust(err)
		tx.Abort()
		_, _ = k.BeginStart(ref, false)
		panic("fault assertion: epoch wrapped")
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(name, "prepare-") || strings.HasPrefix(name, "bindings-") || name == "rollback-errors" {
		_, err := k.BeginStart(ref, false)
		faultCheck(err != nil, "preparation succeeded")
		m := k.machineByID[ref.ID]
		faultCheck(m.state == StateNew && m.current == nil && m.nextEpoch == 2 && len(k.transactions) == 0, "rollback retained machine state")
		for _, p := range []*recordingProvider{fs, net} {
			for _, r := range p.resources {
				faultCheck(r.released, "rollback descriptor leak")
			}
		}
		if name == "prepare-net" {
			faultCheck(slices.Contains(log, "fs:abort"), "missing reverse abort")
		}
		fs.prepareErr, net.prepareErr, fs.badBindings, net.badBindings = nil, nil, false, false
		tx, err := k.BeginStart(ref, false)
		faultMust(err)
		faultCheck(tx.run.ref.Epoch == 2, "failed epoch reused")
		faultMust(tx.Commit())
		faultCheck(errors.Is(tx.Commit(), ErrTxnState), "double commit accepted")
		faultMust(k.Stop(ref, contracts.StopCrash))
		faultMust(k.Stop(ref, contracts.StopCrash))
		return
	}
	switch name {
	case "publish-fs":
		fs.panicPublish = true
	case "publish-net":
		net.panicPublish = true
	case "publish-nil":
		net.nilInstance = true
	case "publish-yield":
		net.yieldPublish = true
	}
	faultMust(k.Start(ref))
	if strings.HasPrefix(name, "publish-") {
		panic("fault assertion: publication corruption returned")
	}
	run := k.machineByID[ref.ID].current
	ctx := contracts.CallContext{Epoch: run.ref}
	switch name {
	case "random-baseline", "random-net":
		ports := k.Ports()
		fsRandom := ports.RandomFor(contracts.FS, ref)
		first := fsRandom.Uint64()
		if name == "random-net" {
			r := ports.RandomFor(contracts.Net, ref)
			for range 1000 {
				_ = r.Uint64()
			}
		}
		data, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"msg": "domain-random", "first": first, "second": fsRandom.Uint64(), "scheduler": k.engine.RandomFor("scheduler", 0).Uint64()})
		simrt.WriteLog(append(data, '\n'))
		return
	case "quiesce":
		net.panicQuiesce = true
	case "settle":
		fs.settleErr = errors.New("settle fault")
	case "release":
		net.releaseErr = errors.New("release fault")
	case "detach":
		net.panicDetach = true
	case "close":
		fs.panicClose = true
	case "destroy":
		fs.panicDestroy = true
	case "cleanup-all":
		fs.settleErr = errors.New("settle fault")
		net.releaseErr = errors.New("release fault")
		net.panicDetach = true
		fs.panicClose = true
	case "fd-overflow":
		r := &dataResource{owner: contracts.RT}
		run.descriptors.next = math.MaxInt32
		fd, err := run.descriptors.Allocate(r)
		faultMust(err)
		faultCheck(fd == math.MaxInt32, "last fd lost")
		_, err = run.descriptors.Allocate(&dataResource{owner: contracts.RT})
		faultCheck(errors.Is(err, syscall.EMFILE), "fd wrapped")
		return
	case "wait-overflow":
		observer, err := k.Create("observer", func() {})
		faultMust(err)
		faultMust(k.Start(observer))
		caller := contracts.CallContext{Epoch: k.machineByID[observer.ID].current.ref}
		k.nextWaitID = contracts.WaitID(math.MaxUint64)
		_, err = k.Wait(caller, ref)
		faultMust(err)
		_, _ = k.Wait(caller, ref)
		panic("fault assertion: wait ID wrapped")
	case "invocation-overflow":
		k.dispatcher.nextID = math.MaxUint64
		first := &Invocation{Context: ctx}
		faultMust(k.dispatcher.admit(first))
		second := &Invocation{Context: ctx}
		faultCheck(k.dispatcher.admit(second) != nil, "invocation ID wrapped")
		return
	case "duplicate-completion":
		inv := &Invocation{Context: ctx}
		faultMust(k.dispatcher.admit(inv))
		id := inv.Context.InvocationID
		faultMust(k.dispatcher.Complete(id, Result{}))
		_ = k.dispatcher.Complete(id, Result{})
		panic("fault assertion: duplicate completion returned")
	case "canceled-call":
		data := []byte("unchanged")
		inv := &Invocation{Context: ctx, Args: [5]any{abi.ByteView{Ptr: data}}, Result: Result{Value: &data}}
		faultMust(k.dispatcher.admit(inv))
		id := inv.Context.InvocationID
		lease := k.dispatcher.live[id]
		k.engine.CancelMachine(token(run))
		k.dispatcher.CancelEpoch(run.ref)
		faultCheck(inv.Args == ([5]any{}) && inv.Result == (Result{}) && lease.invocation == nil && inv.Sema == 0, "cancellation kept borrowed memory")
		faultMust(k.dispatcher.Complete(id, Result{Value: abi.ByteView{Ptr: data}}))
		faultCheck(string(data) == "unchanged" && inv.Result == (Result{}) && inv.Sema == 0, "late completion touched canceled caller")
		faultMust(k.Stop(ref, contracts.StopCrash))
		faultCheck(len(k.dispatcher.canceled) == 0, "cancellation tombstone leaked")
		return
	case "poll-deadline", "poll-overflow", "deadline-overflow":
		r := &dataResource{owner: contracts.RT}
		fd, err := run.descriptors.Allocate(r)
		faultMust(err)
		r.fd = fd
		id, err := k.PollOpen(ctx, fd)
		faultMust(err)
		if name == "poll-overflow" {
			k.nextPollID = math.MaxUint64
			_, err = k.PollOpen(ctx, fd)
			faultMust(err)
			_, _ = k.PollOpen(ctx, fd)
			panic("fault assertion: poll ID wrapped")
		}
		if name == "deadline-overflow" {
			k.polls[id].read.generation = math.MaxUint64
			_ = k.PollDeadline(ctx, id, 1, 'r')
			panic("fault assertion: deadline wrapped")
		}
		inv := &Invocation{Context: ctx, Route: RoutePollWait, Args: [5]any{PollWaitRequest{Handle: id, Mode: 'r'}}}
		k.dispatcher.DispatchOne(inv)
		faultMust(k.PollDeadline(ctx, id, 100, 'r'))
		old := k.polls[id].read.generation
		faultMust(k.PollDeadline(ctx, id, 200, 'r'))
		k.expirePoll(id, old, 'r')
		faultCheck(inv.Sema == 0, "stale deadline completed call")
		simrt.Sleep(210)
		faultCheck(inv.Sema == 1 && inv.Result.Value.(PollWaitResult).Code == 2, "deadline did not complete wait")
		sink := k.polls[id].sink
		faultMust(k.Stop(ref, contracts.StopCrash))
		sink.Notify(ctx.Epoch, fd, contracts.ReadReady)
		faultCheck(len(k.polls) == 0 && len(r.sinks) == 0 && r.released == 1, "canceled poll retained owner")
		return
	case "restart":
		old := run.ref
		faultMust(k.Stop(ref, contracts.StopCrash))
		net.prepareErr = errInjected
		faultCheck(k.Restart(ref) != nil, "restart ignored prepare fault")
		m := k.machineByID[ref.ID]
		faultCheck(m.state == StateCrashed && m.lastExit.Epoch == old.Epoch, "failed restart changed terminal state")
		net.prepareErr = nil
		faultMust(k.Restart(ref))
		faultCheck(!k.Accepts(old) && m.current.ref.Epoch == 3, "restart admitted old epoch")
		return
	}
	faultMust(k.Stop(ref, contracts.StopGraceful))
	if name != "close" && name != "destroy" {
		panic("fault assertion: cleanup fault returned")
	}
}
